name: Johnson Ranch
location: Johnson Ranch loop (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Mellow beginner loop off S. Higuera — good warm-up or ride with the kids.

name: Madonna (Cerro San Luis)
location: Fire road + Lemon Grove singletrack (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Steady fire-road climb with big views over town; singletrack descent.

name: Irish Hills
location: Froom Ranch, Mariposa, Bog Thistle, Ridge trails (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Steep, loose climbs from Madonna Rd / Prefumo Canyon trailheads.

name: Sycamore Springs / Ontario Ridge
location: Fire road up, singletrack over to Shell Beach (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Short, punchy climb up Ontario Ridge with ocean views; ridge singletrack to Shell Beach.

name: Pismo Preserve
location: Discovery Loop + ridge trails (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: ~10 mi open to bikes (Vamonos is hike-only). Closes when muddy.

name: Lopez Lake
location: Duna Vista, Two Waters, Blackberry Spring, Turkey Ridge (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: County park, day-use fee. Hot in summer — go early.

name: West Cuesta Ridge
location: Shooters, Morning Glory/Botanicals, Firebreak, Pick & Shovel, Chrome, Moto, Powerlines (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: The local classic. Paved/fire-road climb, steep technical descents. Can link to Cerro Alto.

name: East Cuesta Ridge
location: Fire road (Upper Lopez Canyon trail at ~6 mi is hiking only) (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Non-technical but a real fitness climb. Turn around where the hike-only trail starts.

name: Montaña de Oro
location: Horse Camp, East Boundary, Islay Creek fire rd, Barranca, Canyon View, Hazard Peak, Oats Peak, Beebe, Manzanita (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Huge variety. Islay Creek is easy; Hazard/Oats Peak climbs and Manzanita are the hard stuff.

name: Cerro Cabrillo (Morro Bay SP)
location: Quarry, Canet, Live Oak, Park Ridge (SLO & Five Cities)
notes: Flowy loops below the Morros near the Morro Bay golf course.

name: Estero Bluffs
location: Coastal bluff trail (North County & Coast)
notes: Flat ocean-bluff cruise north of Cayucos.

name: Whale Rock Reservoir
location: Reservoir roads & trail (North County & Coast)
notes: City-owned; public access is limited (fishing-season hours). Check SLO City before going.

name: Cayucos Hills
location: Hills above the cemetery (bike up past the house) (North County & Coast)
notes: Informal access per your sheet — confirm it's not private land before riding.

name: Cambria
location: Climb to the rock above Coast Union HS (North County & Coast)
notes: Short local climb with coast views.

name: San Simeon Campground
location: Road + singletrack (North County & Coast)
notes: Easy mix of campground roads and creekside singletrack.

name: Cerro Alto (Hwy 41)
location: Cerro Alto loop / Boy Scout / West Cuesta link (North County & Coast)
notes: Steep climb, rocky techy descent. Day-use fee at the campground.

name: Three Bridges (Hwy 41)
location: Lower Three Bridges (upper portion no bikes) (North County & Coast)
notes: Creek crossings; upper section is closed to bikes.

name: Stadium Park (Atascadero)
location: Stadium Park trails (North County & Coast)
notes: Short, steep and a bit techy — right in town.

name: Rocky Canyon (Atascadero)
location: Fire road to the top, road to Creston (North County & Coast)
notes: Fire-road climb. From the top, roll the road to Creston for a milkshake.

name: Santa Margarita Lake — North
location: Blinn Ranch → Sandstone, Sapwi, Falcon (River Rd TH) (North County & Coast)
notes: Quieter north-shore singletrack from the River Road trailhead.

name: Santa Margarita Lake — South
location: Rocky, Grey Pine, Vaca Flats, secret trail to slick-rock overlook (North County & Coast)
notes: Main park entrance; day-use fee. Hot and exposed mid-day.

name: Rinconada
location: Short interwoven loops · Long route: High Mtn Lookout Rd → Big Falls → Belmont Stakes → Deliverance (North County & Coast)
notes: Short fun trails from the Rinconada TH; the long route is a big backcountry day — see your sheet for turn-by-turn.

name: Pozo
location: Turkey Flats, Tower, Black Mountain Rd, Howard Bypass (sketchy), Fernandez (overgrown) (North County & Coast)
notes: Shared with motos (OHV). Loose, steep, remote — bring water & a buddy.

name: Caliente Mountain Ridge Trail
location: Ridge road to Caliente Mtn (Carrizo Plain) (North County & Coast)
notes: Remote, no water, 4WD recommended to the trailhead. Pin is approximate.

name: Prewitt Ridge Downhill
location: Hwy 1 → Nacimiento-Fergusson → South Coast Ridge Rd → Prewitt descent (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: Park at USFS Pacific Valley station. Full directions on your sheet. Big Sur cliffs — serious.

name: Willett-Plaskett
location: Fire-road ascent near Ragged Point / Plaskett Ridge (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: Pin at Plaskett Ridge Rd; your sheet says the fire road starts ~500 ft before Ragged Point — confirm start.

name: Arroyo Seco
location: Indians Rd / Arroyo Seco fire roads (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: Los Padres NF west of Greenfield. Remote, rough roads.

name: Toro Park (Pipeline)
location: Pipeline + ridge loops (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: County park off Hwy 68; connects into Fort Ord. Parking fee.

name: Fort Ord National Monument
location: 80+ mi of singletrack & fire road (Sea Otter country) (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: Endless rolling singletrack. Creekside Terrace / Badger Hills trailheads off Hwy 68.

name: Mudstone Ranch (Hollister Hills)
location: Road Runner, Razorback, Old Ranch Rd (Big Sur & Monterey)
notes: Non-motorized section of Hollister Hills SVRA, Cienega Rd.

name: Orcutt Hills / Santa Maria Open Space
location: Rice Ranch / Orcutt Hills trails (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Rolling oak hills above Orcutt.

name: Los Flores Ranch
location: Los Flores Ranch Park trails (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: City park east of Santa Maria — check hours before going.

name: New Cuyama: Aliso ↑ McPherson ↓
location: Up Aliso, down McPherson from Aliso Park Campground (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Big climb to Sierra Madre ridge, long descent. Very hot in summer.

name: San Rafael / Figueroa Mtn
location: McKinley Rd, White Rock, Davy Brown Trail (overgrown) (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Stay out of the Wilderness boundary (no bikes). Davy Brown is overgrown.

name: Gaviota Peak Road
location: Trespass Trail, Tunnel View Trail (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Steep fire road with ocean views from Gaviota SP.

name: Baron Ranch
location: Loop trail (+ Arroyo Quemado to Camino Cielo) (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Open daily 8 am–sunset, off Hwy 101 west of Goleta.

name: Paradise Road (Santa Ynez River)
location: Snyder, Aliso Canyon, Oso Connector, Camuesa Rd/Connector, Santa Cruz Trail, 19 Oaks, Arroyo Burro (N) (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Lots of options off Paradise Rd; creek crossings after rain. Adventure Pass needed to park.

name: Santa Barbara Front Side
location: Jesusita, Arroyo Burro Frontside, Tunnel, Rattlesnake, Romero Canyon (Santa Maria · Santa Ynez · SB)
notes: Rocky, very technical, busy with hikers — go weekdays and check current bike access per trail.
